title: XOR and the Feature Lift
tagline: Watch the best possible line fail on XOR, then add one column, x₁x₂, and see a flat plane in 3D become a curve in 2D
summary: Train logistic regression on XOR and watch gradient descent settle at the chance loss ln 2, because no straight line can separate the four corners. Append the feature x₁x₂ and the same linear model separates the lifted data with a flat plane in three dimensions. Orbit that plane, look at it edge-on, then look from the top: its trace on the saddle is the hyperbola you see in the input plane.
highlights: Hand-tune or train a logistic regression on XOR and watch the loss floor at ln 2 ≈ 0.693, the loss of guessing 0.5.
Add the column x₁x₂ and see the points lift onto a saddle where one flat plane separates the classes.
Orbit the feature space, snap the camera edge-on to the plane, then look from the top to recover the 2D hyperbola.
Try a decoy feature that does not help and a hand-made ReLU feature that does, the bridge to hidden layers.
